title: mistralrs runner options
description: The run/start options the mistralrs runner takes, each optional. They fill the runner contract's runnerOptions extension point. The model isn't an option: it comes from the run's runtime, the built-in in-process mistralrs, as the absolute path of a GGUF file. Nothing here names a program to run, a file to download or a server to reach.

maxTurns.description: The requests one run may make. Reaching it ends the run with an error result, reason turn-limit. Absent: 50.

contextLength.description: The context window, in tokens: the most the conversation and the answer together may hold. At most the model's own length; a larger one ends the run with an error result, reason configuration. Absent: 16384, or the model's length if that's smaller. The runner bounds every answer to the room left, and a conversation that fills it ends the run with context-length (or, told compact, is compacted). On macOS it is also the engine's KV budget.

temperature.description: The sampling temperature. Absent: the model's own.

seed.description: The sampling seed, given to the engine when it loads the model. Absent: none.

think.description: Whether a thinking model thinks before it answers. Absent: the model's own. The thinking is kept in the transcript only.
